sloka: एवं राजर्षय: सर्वे प्रतीता राजनन्दन ।तस्मात् त्राहि नरश्रेष्ठ पितरं नरकात् प्रभो ॥ २.१०७.१४॥
transliteration: evaṁ rājarṣaya: sarve pratītā rājanandana ।tasmāt trāhi naraśreṣṭha pitaraṁ narakāt prabho ॥ 2.107.14॥

translations.english: O enhancer of the king's delight, O best of men rajarsis have decided this way. You may, therefore, O lord, protect your father against hell.
